description: React component for rendering a team row in the admin console's system user detail view, including team info, role, type, and actions.

classes.name: TeamRow
classes.description: React component class for displaying a team row with team details and actions.

methods.name: renderTeamType
methods.description: Returns a formatted message indicating the team type based on team properties.

methods.name: renderTeamRole
methods.description: Returns a formatted message indicating the user's role in the team.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the JSX for the team row, including team icon, name, description, type, role, and action dropdown.
